bug_1_organizer_prefill.analysis: The fix correctly handles organizer profile pre-fill: 1) Checks useBusinessName flag from user profile, 2) If enabled, uses businessName/businessEmail, 3) Falls back to personal name/email if business fields empty, 4) Final fallback to 'Your Name' prevents empty fields
bug_1_organizer_prefill.key_code: const useBusinessProfile = updatedUser?.useBusinessName || user.useBusinessName || false; const displayName = useBusinessProfile ? (businessName || name) : name; const displayEmail = useBusinessProfile ? (businessEmail || email) : email;

bug_2_stripe_black_screen.analysis: The fix correctly prevents race condition: 1) Line 166 checks 'event && !isSuccess && !isProcessingPayment' before processing, 2) Line 257 only calls checkSuccess() when event is truthy, 3) Event is in dependency array ensuring re-run when loaded
